## PP prepack BOM flip (hourly)
Fulfil always explodes a kit with its lowest-sequence BOM, so each kit has a '1 x PP' BOM and a singles BOM; this sets which one is sequence 10 from PP stock at the kit's market warehouse (min `minPP`). Stock is derived from stock moves (live location-context quantities read 0 over the API).

Safety: `dryRun` true = preview email only. Writes go through 'Fulfil | Request (sub-workflow)', which blocks PROD writes unless `allowProdWrite` is true. Every write is read back and emailed with old/new sequence (the revert record). One-time setup of new kits is NOT done here (reported only).

Built by Claude for Ben 23-Oct-26, replaces the local pp_bom_flip.py run. Starts on SANDBOX. Go-live (Diviyaj): Settings tenant/baseUrl = PROD, read nodes to Fulfil PROD credential, dryRun false, allowProdWrite true.
